additional_info.subject: ID0474312-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / R9 313202799058] Random SECC Initialization Error CRM:03055000544
additional_info.body:
Dear Cedric,
Thank you for contacting our eMobility Support.
We're pleased to inform you that the issue previously identified with your SiCharge D charging station, indicated by the "
vendorErrorCode: secc is initializing
" message, has now cleared, and the station is now fully operational.
Following a thorough review and deeper system diagnostics, we confirmed that the root cause involved an intermittent Ethernet connection drop. Additionally, we identified a minor software bug that contributed to the persistent initialization message. This bug has since been automatically rectified by the system.
As a result, the associated errors have cleared, and your charging station is now healthy and properly working, available for use. No manual intervention was required on our part to restore functionality.
We will continue to monitor the charger's performance over the next few days. Should the error recur, we will take immediate action to resolve it. Otherwise, we will proceed to close this ticket.
Best regards,
Ivan
Siemens eMobility Technical Support Team
